spec.description: Fleet monitoring for Cascade VPN and AmneziaWG using Cascade's native Prometheus metrics.
Healthy selected Cascade targets compared with all selected targets.
spec.title: Cascade Instances

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, interface, peer_id, name) (rate(cascade_peer_received_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance",interface=~"$interface",name=~"$peer"}[5m])) * 8)

spec.description: Top peers by five-minute receive rate. Traffic counters are converted to bits per second with rate().
spec.title: Top Peers by RX Rate

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, interface, peer_id, name) (rate(cascade_peer_sent_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance",interface=~"$interface",name=~"$peer"}[5m])) * 8)

spec.description: Top peers by five-minute transmit rate.
spec.title: Top Peers by TX Rate

spec.description: Outbound traffic observed since the start of the current calendar day. The value is limited by available Prometheus samples.
spec.title: Outbound Traffic Today

spec.description: Outbound traffic observed since the start of the current calendar month. The value is limited by available Prometheus samples and retention.
spec.title: Outbound Traffic This Month

spec.description: Cascade-maintained lifetime totals survive ordinary interface restarts, but are operational counters rather than billing records.
spec.title: Top Peers by Lifetime Traffic

spec.description: Handshake age is a recency signal, not authoritative session state. Default connected threshold is 180 seconds.
spec.title: Last Handshake Age

spec.description: Status mapping: healthy=1, degraded=0.5, down/admin_down/unknown=0. Exact state is included by cascade_gateway_info.
spec.title: Gateway Status

spec.description: Seconds since Prometheus last observed a completed Cascade metrics collection.
spec.title: Metrics Collection Age

spec.description: Collection errors grouped by Cascade target over the selected time range.
spec.title: Metrics Collection Errors
